title: Nasruddin and the Silver Spoon
summary: At a royal banquet, Nasruddin slipped a silver spoon into his turban. The king noticed and said: "Mulla, perform a magic trick for us!"...
full_text:
At a royal banquet, Nasruddin slipped a silver spoon into his turban. The king noticed and said: "Mulla, perform a magic trick for us!"

Nasruddin announced: "I shall place this silver spoon into my mouth, and make it reappear inside the turban of the wisest man in the room!" He swallowed an ordinary spoon, reached into his own turban, and pulled out the royal silver spoon with a triumphant bow!
moral: Concealing guilt with clumsy pretense only draws brighter light upon the deed.
